data.summary: Returns a list of organizations matching the given search terms. Params: q (keyword), page (0-indexed), state[id] (e.g. NY), ntee[id] (1-10 major groups), c_code[id] (subsection code).
data.description:
Returns a list of organizations matching the given search terms.
Parameters (all optional):
- q: Keyword search string (org name, alternate name, city).
- page: Page number (0-indexed).
- state[id]: State abbreviation (e.g. 'NY').
- ntee[id]: NTEE Major Group ID (1-10, e.g. 1=Arts, 7=Health).
- c_code[id]: Subsection code (e.g. 3 for 501(c)(3)).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A keyword search string. Searches organization name, organization alternate name, city.

parameters.name: state_id
parameters.description: State abbreviation code (e.g. 'NY', 'CA'). Maps to state[id] parameter.

parameters.name: ntee_id
parameters.description: National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities (NTEE) Major Group ID (1-10). Maps to ntee[id] parameter.

parameters.name: c_code_id
parameters.description: Subsection code ID (e.g. 3 for 501(c)(3)). Maps to c_code[id] parameter.

data.summary: Returns all available data for a given organization, by the organization's integer EIN.
data.description: Returns all available data for a given organization including filings.
